0022600094.text: Neither team has played a 2026-27 game yet, and the Hawks, the visiting team, are missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while the Hornets are without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee). In the 2025-26 season series, the Hawks lost 1-3, and there have been no games between the teams yet this season. The most recent meeting was on February 11 in Charlotte, where the Hawks lost 110-107.
